description: Ministry of Industries - The Societies Ordinance (Society known as "Live to Love Lanka" ) The Societies Ordinance (Society known as Sri Rajakeeya  Padanama)
categorisation: This gazette content involves the Minister of Industries exercising powers under the Societies Ordinance (Chapter 123) to authorize and limit the application of the ordinance to specific societies. This constitutes a regulatory action involving statutory instruments and legal provisions, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette. While it mentions a government minister by name, it does not describe his portfolio responsibilities or constitute a personnel change, and the primary focus is on regulatory implementation rather than government structure or personnel matters.
